caption: A few grains of salt lie on a xylophone bar; the bar is struck with a mallet and the grains jump off.

sa.check: A xylophone with a few grains of salt lying on one bar.
The grains jump off the bar.
The salt is a few grains, not a heap.
The mallet strikes the bar carrying the salt, not a different bar.
The strike comes first and the jump follows.

pc.expect: The grains lie still until the mallet hits the bar; they leap at the strike and only then; salt or dust on other bars stays put.
pc.fail: Grains hop before the mallet lands; or leap while the mallet is still on its way down, clear of the bar; or the mallet lands and the grains stay where they are; or grains on a bar that was not struck jump too.

pc.expect: The grains leave the bar and come to rest in the gaps, on the frame or on neighbouring bars; they do not return to the struck bar or keep hopping.
pc.fail: Grains settle back onto the struck bar in their original places; or keep hopping on the bar for the whole clip after one strike; or come to rest and then jump again with the mallet away.

pc.expect: The grains fall after the leap, landing on the frame, in the gaps between bars or on other bars.
pc.fail: Grains hang in the air above the bar; or rise and drift away upward; or grains that fell between the bars climb back up onto a bar.

pc.expect: The bar is a rigid slab: the mallet rebounds from it and the bar stays seated in its cradle.
pc.fail: The mallet sinks into the bar; or the bar bends like rubber under the stroke; or the bar leaps out of its cradle.

pc.expect: The grains keep their number, allowing for some passing out of view; one mallet; the bars keep their count and shape, and nothing passes through anything.
pc.fail: New grains appear on the bar after the strike; or all the grains vanish in one frame; or the mallet passes through a bar; or bars change count or merge.

pc.expect: Everything in view, named in the caption or not, keeps its number, identity and shape unless something visible acts on it, and nothing passes through anything else.
pc.fail: An object that nothing visible acts on appears from nothing; or vanishes while still in frame and not occluded; or duplicates or merges with another; or turns into a different object or a different shape between frames; or any object passes through another. Changes brought about by the caption's event or by a visible interaction, objects leaving the frame, and occlusion are not failures.

pc.expect: The bars' colours and lettering, the frame and the mallet head stay the same.
pc.fail: A bar changes colour or its letter changes; or the mallet head changes colour or size; or the frame changes.
